text: This report recommends a multi-year agreement between a Corporate Client and Exhibition Place within Beanfield Centre.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved three license agreements with the Corporate Client for Beanfield Centre as set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 5, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, for a 3-year term commencing in 2019 and expiring in 2021 on the terms and conditions of the Event Agreement and such other terms and conditions satisfactory to the Chief Executive Officer and City Solicitor. 2. Directed the confidential information in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 5, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place remain confidential as it pertains to the security of the property of the Board.
